name: cdm/product/asset/floatingrate/FloatingRateSettingDetails
description: Type for reporting the raw (untreated) observed or calculated rate for a calculation period.  If this is a calculated rate, it allows details of the observations and the resulting rate to be returned.

calculationDetails.description: Calculated rate details (observation dates, values, and weights).

floatingRate.description: The resulting rate that was observed or calculated.

observationDate.description: The day upon which the rate was observed (for term rates).

resetDate.description: The day for which the rate is needed (e.g. period beginning or end date).
